name: class-timetable
title: Class timetable
description: A weekly timetable for a gym, school or studio: the week at a glance on wide screens, a day at a time on a phone, with spots left and full classes in words.
docs: Pass days with Monday first, each with its classes (start and end on the 24-hour clock; 9:30 and 09:30 both work, and the classes are listed by the clock). The week is a grid once the timetable itself is 64rem wide, about 9rem a day; narrower, and in a narrow column on a wide screen, day tabs open on today. today is the id of the current day: work it out for your visitor's time zone, or leave it out and nothing is marked. spots: 0 flags a class as Full in words and with a dashed edge, and waitlistHref adds the waitlist link only then, named after its class for screen readers (labels.waitlistFor words that). locale decides how times are written: en-US 6:30 PM, en-GB 18:30. A range that does not fit its card wraps after the dash. legend is a line under the timetable. Pass linkAs={Link} to route the class links.
